landing.heroDescription: Create personalized travel itineraries in seconds, collaborate with friends, and make decisions together. Your dream vacation starts here.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Powerful features to make travel planning effortless
landing.aiItinerariesDesc: Generate detailed day-by-day travel plans instantly using advanced AI technology tailored to your preferences.
landing.collaborativePlanningDesc: Invite friends and family to plan together. Everyone can suggest activities and vote on the best options.
landing.realtimeChatDesc: Discuss plans with your travel group in real-time. Make decisions faster and keep everyone in the loop.
landing.activityVotingDesc: Vote on activities to reach group consensus. Resolve conflicts democratically and ensure everyone has a great time.
landing.smartSchedulingDesc: AI considers travel time, opening hours, and optimal routing to create realistic schedules that work.
landing.locationAwareDesc: Get suggestions based on your destination with local insights, popular attractions, and hidden gems.
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: Three simple steps to your perfect itinerary
landing.step1Desc: Share your destination, dates, group size, interests, and budget. The more we know, the better your itinerary.
landing.step2Desc: Our AI creates a personalized day-by-day itinerary with activities, timing, and cost estimates in seconds.
landing.step3Desc: Invite your travel companions, discuss options, vote on activities, and finalize your perfect trip together.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join thousands of travelers planning amazing trips with Voyagely
